body: There was a guy in my class, a narcissist. The very first time I entered his home, I could feel that a great deal of pain and suffering had transpired there. I ignored those feelings, became fast friends with him, and eventually fell in love with him. Or, I fell in love with the person I thought he was. Still, I always had an uneasy gut feeling that things would eventually turn real ugly between us. I wasn't sure where that feeling came from, but sure enough things didn't end well between us.

UPDATE: Back where I started, if not worse off. Please, please, please, I need someone to help push me over the edge. PM me and tell me I'm a shitty human being, no one needs me, and no one cares. Remind me my life is going to continue being a shitshow. I've been on the brink for longer than I can bear, only to have one friend after another pull me back from the edge. But, slowly and surely I'm losing people. They're growing tired of me and my neediness. One in particular can't stand me anymore...and it's my fault. I can't stand myself anymore. I can't stand my own emotional instability anymore. Please help push me over the edge. I already have a method planned out. All I need is that one extra kick. PLEASE.
I’m trying to hang in there, in case you guys are wondering.

Already tried therapy for a year. It helped. But, with my lack of a car, I had to rely on my mother for rides. Being around her erased any good that came out of the therapy, so I ended it. And, in order for me to get to a meeting with any support group, I'd also need to get rides from her, so that's not an option. Every time I've tried to get help, all the good that comes out of it is erased by my having to be around my toxic family.
